rows.abstract: Rationale:  In the rural areas, particularly in the Visayas and Mindanao provinces and coastal towns, the common man's basic needs of sea transportation is the motorized banca. Even in the coastal towns of Central Luzon, the motorized banca is the primary means of transporting goods and people by river and sea. > Under the present law, the motorized banca owner/proprieto r is required to file his petition for the issuance off a certificate of public convenience in Manila with the Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA). there is a need for him to be represented by a lawyer as there is that requirement of a public hearing." States that thee power to issue Certificates of Public Convenience to motorized bancas shall be devolved from the Maritimme Industry Authority the principal business of the operation is located.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A 'WOMEN'S MULTI-RESOURCE CENTER' IN ALL CITIES AND PROVINCES IN THE COUNTRY, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Prescribes the functions of the Center, namely: (1) To serve as the local focal point women's concerns; (2) To serve as a venue ffor training in traditional and non-traditional occuaptions capability building and functional literacy training in andas a placement agency which will provide women with means to alleviate poverty. (3) To advocate for women's gender-responsi ve development and protection in their perssons, dignity, rights andd opportunities, towards equal partnership with me or in family law ccommunity development and nation building; (4) To mobilize barangay women into networks for the protection of women and chidlren, report cases of abuses, assist victims andd provide supportive services. (5) to provide moral recovery and vaalues formation, counselling, psycho-social programs and temporary shelter for disadvantaged women and girls; (6) To serve as a temporary shelter when a woman finds herself in a crisis situation.

rows.title_full: THE REVISED INVESTMENT COMPANY ACT
rows.abstract: "The Revised Investment Company Act" Declares  it the policy of the State to foster and promote a fair, orderly and efficient capital market in order to provide the private and public sectors with access to funds that are vital to the development ofthe national economy.> An investment company, by its nature, brings together large concentrations of funds from the public which are entrusted for investment to the management of others. This Act seeks, therefore, to establish a comprehensive schemeof regulation to permit investment companies to serrve their role in the capital formation process.

rows.abstract: "Philippine Sports Academy Act of 1995" Provides for the establishment of a Philippine Sports Academy which shall serve as a specialized education and training center for ahtletes, as well as sports officials  and coaches. Article XIII of the Constitution provides that: "The Congress shall give highest priority to the enactment of measures that protect and enhance the right of all the people to human dignity, reduce social, economic, and political inequities, and remove cultural inequities by equitably diffusing the State shall regulate the acquisition, ownership, use, and disposition of property and its increments." rows.abstract: Rationale: "Last August 12, 1996, Phase I (Transition Phase) of the deregulation Act took effect. During this initial phase the prices of petroleum products, such as unleaded, premium, regular and diesel fuel increased. rows.abstract: Rationale: "The Constitution provides that the State shall ensure the autonomy of local governments. One way of achieving such autonomy is to entrust into the hands of the LGUs the funds for local road projects. > Poses these objectives: (1) To decentralize the management of public works funds intended for road projects of LGUs and prevent the delay in the implementation thereof; and (2) To ensure the full implementation of road projects or infrastructure in the countryside."

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE TRADITIONAL AND ALTERNATIVE HEALTH CARE INSTITUTE TO ACCELERATE THE DEVELOPMENT OF TRADITIONAL AND ALTERNATIVE HEALTH CARE IN THE PHILIPPINES, PROVIDING FOR A TRADITIONAL AND ALTERNATIVE HEALTH CARE DEVELOPMENT FUND, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: It is about time for us to explore the potentials of our health care resources. Some 7,000 speccies of medicinal plants await scientific investigation of their therapeutic value. Developing traditional and alternative medicine will produce low-cost, effective and affordable supplements to the existing health care system. Using indigenous skills and materials will aslo enhance cultural acceptability leadding to wider utilization of these health care modalities. Even the World Health Organization (WHO) recognizes the importance of traditional healing methods, particularly among developing countries." "Traditional and alternative Health Care Development Act of 1996" Aims to --- (1) encourage scientific research on the development oof traditional and alternative health care systems, especially those addressing preventive care and with direct impact on public health; (2) promote and advocate the use of traditional and alterantive health care modalities that have been proven safe
rows.status: Substituted by HB10070
